**LICENSE — compliant (preferred level).** No redline proposed.

- **Affiliates & contractors:** §13.1 grants the hosted-service rights to "Customer, its Affiliates, and contractors acting on their behalf"; §13.2 covers Affiliates and contractor support for paid-up material — better than the fallback (no written-notice condition).
- **Paid-up perpetual/irrevocable:** §13.2 — "perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, fully paid licence"; reinforced by §10 (paid-up licences survive) and §14.3.
- **Subscription licence revocation:** §13.3 limits Vendor revocation/suspension to a material uncured payment or use breach after notice and cure; §9 gives Vendor termination only for material breach, so there is no at-will revocation.
- **Successor transfer:** §13.3 plus §24.1 (assignment to an Affiliate or M&A successor without Vendor consent), with §24.4 blocking Vendor repricing or termination on Customer change of control.
